about: All spoken lines of the mission. Each line becomes one FXT subtitle (key V3D<id>), one audio file (cleo\99sure\audio\V3D<id>.mp3) and one entry in the VO recording script. 'exact': true marks lines taken word for word from the mission brief. 'gesture' is an upper-body animation played on the speaker while the line runs (see tools/gen_text.py). 'direction' is a note for the voice actor.

CJ.voice: Carl Johnson. Original performance; do not imitate the game's actor.

CHRIS.voice: Christopher Woodyard. Calm, curious, conversational; dry humour; never lectures.

MAX.voice: Max Certainty, SureThing CEO. Keynote-stage bravado, absolutely sure of everything.

DISPATCH.voice: Police radio dispatcher. Flat, procedural, radio-filtered.

CERTAIN.voice: CERTAIN system voice. Synthetic, pleasant, corporate, overconfident.

NEWS.voice: TV news anchor. Measured, broadcast cadence.

RADIO.voice: Morning-radio host / ad announcer. Bright, fast.

DENTIST.voice: Audience member in row three, indignant.

lines.speaker: CERTAIN
lines.text: Predictive alert. Subject: Carl Johnson. Threat level: critical. Confidence: ninety-nine point nine percent.

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: All units, CERTAIN priority hit in Doherty. Subject Carl Johnson. Approach with confidence.

lines.speaker: COP
lines.text: Carl Johnson! CERTAIN says you're about to commit a crime. Stay where you are!

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, I ain't even done nothing!

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: About to? Forget this!

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: Subject is fleeing, exactly as CERTAIN predicted. Confidence is now one hundred and four percent.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: That ain't even a number!

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: Units, CERTAIN advises the subject is probably guilty of something.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Probably? Y'all chasing me on probably?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Carl Johnson?

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Who's this?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Christopher Woodyard. I think I know why the police were chasing you.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Then you better start explaining.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Meet me at my laboratory.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: You got a laboratory?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: More or less.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, what does that even mean?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: It means there's a garage in Doherty with a lot of cables in it. You'll see.
lines.direction: a small smile you can hear

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: In tech news, SureThing Technologies says CERTAIN has eliminated ninety-nine point nine percent of uncertainty in San Fierro.

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: The remaining point one percent is reportedly being chased through Doherty right now. Back after this.

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: CERTAIN. Why wonder, when you can know? SureThing Technologies. The future is certain.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So you're the guy who called me?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Christopher Woodyard.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Carl Johnson.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: I know. The system's been talking about you all morning.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Well, tell that system to mind its business.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: You built all this?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Most of it.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: By yourself?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Pretty much.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: What you running here, some secret government operation?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: No. Independent research.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Sounds like something a secret government operation would say.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Every red dot on this map is a CERTAIN prediction from the last two days.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The system keeps making decisions it can't justify.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So it's broken?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's what we're going to investigate.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: And what's all this? Some kind of super computer?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: This is R.A.I.N. It doesn't predict anything. It checks.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: It weighs the evidence, keeps track of what we don't know, and tells us when we shouldn't decide at all.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: A computer that says 'I don't know'? Where was that when I was in school?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: It's a rare skill. Most systems are built to always have an answer.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Here's your file. CERTAIN flagged you for standing near an incident report... while wearing green.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, I'm from Grove Street. Everybody wears green!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: So you tell me. Accept, reject, or abstain?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Reject. There's an independent log that puts you here at the garage the whole time. The claim falls apart.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: You just accepted a claim that says you're a criminal. Bold choice. Look at the garage log again.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Abstaining is for when we don't have evidence. Here we do, and it points the other way. Try again.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Aight. So what now?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Now we go out and collect our own observations. CERTAIN flagged three sites this morning.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: My van's outside. You drive. I've seen how you handle the police.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Funny. Real funny.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: I'm told I'm hilarious. Mostly by me.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: First stop, Downtown. CERTAIN says there's a paramilitary cell training in a public plaza.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: In broad daylight? That's either real dumb or real confident.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Or it isn't what CERTAIN thinks it is.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So why don't you just hack the thing and shut it off?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Shutting it off proves nothing. Measuring it does.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, you sound like my old math teacher.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Was he right?

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: ...Sometimes.

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: Tired of not knowing things? Let CERTAIN know them for you. Side effects may include being arrested for things you haven't done yet.
lines.direction: ad read, speeds up on the disclaimer

lines.speaker: CERTAIN
lines.text: Alert. Paramilitary training cell detected. Confidence: ninety-seven point two percent.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: That's a bunch of old folks doing tai chi.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Probably. But probably isn't evidence. Take the camera and photograph them from all three markers.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Got it. Average age of the participants: seventy-one.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Second angle. Weapons: none. Thermos: one. Possibly herbal tea.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Third angle. There's a flyer. Golden Dragon Tai Chi, Tuesdays and Thursdays.

lines.speaker: SENIOR
lines.text: Young man! Either join the class or stop taking pictures!

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Sorry, ma'am! It's for science!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Okay. Let's see what R.A.I.N. makes of it.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Reject. Three independent observations, all pointing the same way.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accept? Carl, she's holding a thermos.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We don't have to abstain here. We have plenty of evidence, and it says no.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Abstain. One blurry frame isn't evidence of anything. Not knowing is an answer too.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Based on what? One blurry photo of a woman doing tai chi?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We can't reject it either. We just don't have the data. That's an abstain.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So sometimes the answer is just 'I don't know.'

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Sometimes it's the most honest answer there is.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Next stop, Easter Basin. A delivery van that CERTAIN rates as an explosives transport.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Explosives? And we're driving towards it?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We're going to follow it. Not touch it. If we damage it, our evidence is worthless.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Follow it without touching it. Like a cop, but good.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Like a scientist. Similar uniform. Worse funding.

lines.speaker: CERTAIN
lines.text: Alert. Vehicle classified as explosives transport. Confidence: ninety-nine point one percent.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's the van. Stay back, thirty or forty meters. The sensors will do the rest.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Thermal's reading warm. Consistent with... baking?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Too close. Give him some room.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: My bad, my bad.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We're losing him. Close the gap.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Chemical sniffer says flour, sugar and yeast. It's either a bomb or it's breakfast.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, now I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: DRIVER
lines.text: Morning! Four dozen rolls for the shelter, same as every Tuesday!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: He's stopped. Park close so we can finish the readings.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Reject. It's bread, Carl. Very confidently classified bread.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We followed it across town. It delivered bread.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We don't need to abstain. We measured it. It's bread.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accept. The confidence score is low, but the evidence holds. Two separate measurements agree.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Our own radar clocked him at seventy-four. The claim's right.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We have two measurements that agree. That's enough to accept.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Wait, so CERTAIN got one right?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: A small one, with weak confidence. It's the big confident ones that worry me.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Last site, industrial Doherty. CERTAIN says somebody's jamming the port radar from there.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Jamming? Like... with jam?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: With a transmitter, allegedly. The readings are unstable, so we compare locations. That's the trick.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Compare locations. Got it. I think.

lines.speaker: CERTAIN
lines.text: Alert. Deliberate signal jamming detected. Confidence: ninety-three point four percent.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Park on each marker and hold still. One by the generators, one far away, one in between.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Reading A. Strong hum. Sixty hertz, plus harmonics.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Reading B. Baseline. Nice and clean.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Reading C. It falls off with distance. That's not a transmitter. That's the generator.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Hold still. The reading's smearing.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's all three. Let's look.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Reject. It's electrical noise from heavy equipment. Annoying, but not criminal.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: There's no modulation. No pattern. It's a generator, Carl.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Three readings that agree. We can reject this one.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Abstain. We never measured the radar. We can't say anything about tonight.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We never looked at the radar. Accepting that is just guessing.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We can't reject it either. No data, no verdict.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Okay. I'm starting to get this.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Logging all of it. Every reading, every decision. Even the wrong ones.

lines.speaker: CERTAIN
lines.text: Critical alert. Hostile vehicle. Threat level: severe. Confidence: ninety-nine point nine percent.

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: All units, CERTAIN severe alert. Blue Moonbeam minivan, Garcia. All units converge.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Wait. Look at this. It's a minivan registered to a family. No observations. No priors. Nothing.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The police are about to box in a family because a model is confident.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Not if we get there first.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Chris, your computer better be right about this!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: I'm not asking you to trust the computer.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Then what am I supposed to trust?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The evidence.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, that sounded a lot cooler in your head!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We're here. Stay close to them. I'm streaming our observations straight to dispatch.

lines.speaker: MOTHER
lines.text: Why are the police following us? We're going to my son's recital!

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Keep driving, ma'am! We got you!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Upload at fifty percent. Keep them in range.

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: Units, hold position. We're receiving independent sensor data on the Moonbeam.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Too far! The upload's stalling!

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: All units, stand down. CERTAIN alert rescinded pending review. Repeat, stand down.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Ha! You hear that? Stand down!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Logs preserved. Every observation, timestamped. Nobody gets to pretend this didn't happen.

lines.speaker: MOTHER
lines.text: Thank you! Whoever you are!

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Just two guys with a van and a whole lot of evidence.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The police are almost on them. Hurry!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: SureThing is doing a live demo downtown. Max Certainty, on stage, in front of everybody.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: And we're gonna crash it.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We're going to ask questions. Loudly. With data.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: San Fierro! Welcome to the future. And the future is CERTAIN!

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Our artificial intelligence is so advanced that it no longer needs to question itself.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Yeah, that explains a lot.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Doubt was a legacy feature. We removed it in version two!

lines.speaker: REPORTER
lines.text: Mister Certainty, what about the reports of false alerts?

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: There are no false alerts. Only truths that haven't happened yet!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Then you won't mind a live test.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: And who are you supposed to be?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Christopher Woodyard, Vers3Dynamics. Three predictions. Three independent checks. Right here, right now.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Fine! Let's show these people what ninety-nine point nine percent looks like!

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Prediction one! The man in row three, aisle seat. Pickpocket. Ninety-nine point nine percent!

lines.speaker: DENTIST
lines.text: What? I'm a dentist!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Rejected. Our camera watched him the whole time. His hands were in his own pockets.

lines.speaker: REPORTER
lines.text: So the system was confidently wrong?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Confidently. Wrong.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Ha! See? Even your little machine agrees with me!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: No. That one's on us. Let's run it properly.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Prediction two! CERTAIN forecasts rain at exactly four fifteen this afternoon!

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Rain? Like your computer?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Abstain. There isn't a weather sensor anywhere in that system. That's not a forecast. It's a guess with a decimal point.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accept it based on what? There's no weather data at all.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We can't reject it either. We don't know. That's the whole point.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Prediction three! CERTAIN estimates this crowd now exceeds the plaza's safe capacity. Seventy-six percent!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accept. We counted two hundred and fourteen people, two different ways. The sign says one fifty.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Ha! You see? CERTAIN is right!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: This time. Because the evidence says so, not because it sounded sure. Somebody open the barriers.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: No, the counts are clear. This one's supported.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We have two independent counts. We can decide this one.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Your system refused to answer!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Then your system failed!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: No. It recognized that the evidence was insufficient.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Our system is ninety-nine point nine percent confident!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Confidence isn't evidence.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, somebody write that down.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: That's enough! Cut the feed! Shut it down! Shut everything down!

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, he just turned the whole thing off!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: What do you mean it doesn't matter?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The experiment's already published.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Published where?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Open-source research registry.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So anybody can see it?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Anybody can examine it, reproduce it, or challenge it.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Even that guy?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Especially that guy.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: Breaking news. San Fierro officials have suspended the CERTAIN automated enforcement pilot, pending an independent review.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: The move follows a public demonstration and an openly published dataset from independent lab Vers3Dynamics, documenting specific failures in the system's predictions.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: Researchers stressed the findings concern CERTAIN's documented behavior, not artificial intelligence as a whole.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: SureThing Technologies declined to comment. Confidently.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So that registry thing... anybody could've checked your work this whole time?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's the idea. If I'm wrong, I want to find out fast.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Most people don't want to find out they're wrong.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Most people aren't running experiments.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Hm. Fair.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So what now? You gonna sell your research?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, why am I not surprised?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: I'm going to keep experimenting.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: You know, with all this attention, you could probably make millions.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So why don't you?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Because the important thing is making the technology trustworthy.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: You're a strange dude, Chris.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: I've heard.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Hey, Carl.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Thanks for helping.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Just don't let another computer put the cops on me.
